note: First live-play prototype. Targets retuned by player count (fairness analysis, 31 Oct). Strips list values for 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 players. Vows simplified 31 Oct: one rule, one 'End with...' target and one strip each; the Overstrain allowance is a fixed clause (one at a time at 4 to 5 players). Wording rewritten 2 Nov: each sentence states the requirement and marks the counted thing '(see table)'.

top.name: The First Crossing
top.text: Join tiles on the two river banks with Bridge crossings (see table). Each crossing needs its own Bridge.

bottom.name: The River Kept Calm
bottom.text: No tile beside River/Water may ever be Overstrained (at 4 to 5 players, one may be Overstrained at a time). End with tiles on riverbank hexes (see table).

top.name: No Hearth Stands Alone
top.text: End with Housing tiles (see table), each beside another Housing tile.

bottom.name: No Cold Hearth
bottom.text: No Housing tile may ever be Overstrained (at 4 to 5 players, one may be Overstrained at a time). End with Housing tiles (see table).

top.name: Corners of the Vale
top.text: Have tiles on corner hexes (see table). The corners are A1, A9, N1 and N9.

bottom.name: The Borders Held
bottom.text: No tile on an edge hex may ever be Overstrained (at 4 to 5 players, one may be Overstrained at a time). End with tiles on edge hexes (see table).

top.name: A Settlement of Many Hands
top.text: Have tiles in different categories (see table).

bottom.name: Patchwork
bottom.text: Never place a tile beside another of its own category (Housing, Travel and Resource tiles are exempt). End with tiles in different categories (see table).

top.name: Lands Remembered
top.text: Have tiles on different terrains (see table), not counting River/Water.

bottom.name: The Whole Vale
bottom.text: At the end, all at once: tiles on corner hexes and on different terrains (see table), and both banks joined by a Bridge.

top.name: The Home Farms
top.text: End with Farmsteads (see table), each beside a Housing tile.

bottom.name: The Four Storehouses
bottom.text: End with at least the number in the table of each: Lumber Yard, Mine Tunnel, Gathering Outpost and Farmstead.

top.name: The Mine Road
top.text: End with Mine Tunnels (see table), each beside a Travel tile.

bottom.name: The Resource Crown
bottom.text: End with kinds of Resource tile (see table) that each have two copies placed, both upgraded.

top.name: The Fair Day
top.text: Have Merchant tiles (see table), each beside a Housing, a Social and a Travel tile.

bottom.name: The Heart of the Vale
bottom.text: Ring one tile with six others, the seven covering different categories (see table). At 4 to 5 players, none of the seven may hold Strain.

top.name: Shelter and Song
top.text: End with a connected Housing cluster (size in table) beside both a Social and a Wellbeing tile.

bottom.name: One Great Hearth
bottom.text: End with one connected cluster of Housing tiles (size in table).

top.name: The Care Ring
top.text: Have Care Rings (see table): a Wellbeing tile ringed by six tiles, at least 4 of them Housing, Social or Wellbeing.

bottom.name: Garden Community
bottom.text: End with a Common Land ringed by six tiles, with Housing tiles in the ring (see table). At 4 to 5 players, none of the seven may hold Strain.

top.name: The Quiet Courtyard
top.text: Have courtyards (see table): six tiles ringed round an empty hex, in at least 4 categories.

bottom.name: The Ring Road
bottom.text: Make a closed loop of Travel tiles with tiles inside it (see table).

top.name: Mended Before Nightfall
top.text: In a single round, remove Strain (see table) from tiles in at least 2 categories (any tiles when solo).

bottom.name: The Vale Bent, Not Broken
bottom.text: Have Overstrained tiles at the same time (see table), then end the game with none.

top.name: Sheltered District
top.text: End with Supported tiles (see table) across at least 3 categories (2 when solo).

bottom.name: Not One Lost
bottom.text: No tile may ever be Overstrained (at 4 to 5 players, one may be Overstrained at a time). End with no more Strain on the map than the table shows.

top.name: Good Work Made Last
top.text: Upgrade tiles over the course of the game (see table).

bottom.name: No Fine Work
bottom.text: Never upgrade a Core tile, by any means. End with Housing tiles (see table), each beside another Housing tile.

top.name: Work and Rest
top.text: End with a Washhouse beside a Crafting, a Merchant and a Social tile, and also a Housing tile at 4 to 5 players.

bottom.name: The Unbroken Vale
bottom.text: At no time may more tiles hold 2 or more Strain than the table shows.

top.name: The Market Track
top.text: End with Workshops and Market Stalls (see table for each), all beside the same Track.

bottom.name: No Roads Raised
bottom.text: Never place a Travel tile, by any means (Common Land counts as Travel). End with tiles in different categories (see table).

top.name: The Crossroads
top.text: Have a Travel tile beside three other Travel tiles and a Merchant tile.

bottom.name: The Long Road
bottom.text: Make one connected line of Travel tiles joining the rows in the table. At 4 to 5 players it must also join column A to column N.

top.name: The River Is Welcomed
top.text: End with tiles beside River/Water from Housing, Merchant, Social and Wellbeing: as many different kinds as the table shows.

bottom.name: Twin Villages
bottom.text: On each bank, end with a Housing cluster (size in table) beside a Social tile, and join the banks with a Bridge.

top.name: Hearths in Every Land
top.text: End with Housing tiles on different terrains (see table), not counting Grasslands.

bottom.name: One Village
bottom.text: Every Housing tile must join the one Housing cluster when it is placed. End with that cluster at the size in the table.

top.name: Bread, Stone and Timber
top.text: End with a Lumber Yard, Mine Tunnel and Farmstead all beside one connected Travel group, and also a Gathering Outpost at 4 to 5 players.

bottom.name: No Road Through
bottom.text: No Travel tile may ever be beside a Housing tile. End with tiles in different categories (see table).

top.name: Stone over Running Water
top.text: End with Bridges (see table), at least one upgraded to Stone Bridge.

bottom.name: Clean Slate
bottom.text: End the game with no more Strain on the map than the table shows.
